title: Bicol college suspends classes, office ops after reported bomb threat

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Bicol State College of Applied Sciences and Technology (BISCAST) in Naga City, Camarines Sur, suspended in-person classes and halted office operations following an unverified bomb threat reportedly received by its administration on Saturday, Nov. 14. In an advisory, the college said the measures were implemented upon the recommendation and guidance of the Philippine National Police (PNP) and other concerned authorities. All face-to-face classes were suspended immediately until further notice, while scheduled afternoon classes were shifted to synchronous and asynchronous online learning.
